dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agency personnel responsible for compiling the report and congressional committees receiving it.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary shall submit to the Committees on Veterans' Affairs of the House of Representatives and the Senate a report

dimensions.assessment: The effect is administrative, requiring reporting and documentation rather than changing substantive benefits or duties.
dimensions.evidence: submit to Congress an annual report on the National Cemetery Administration

dimensions.assessment: No specific appropriations or federal spending increases are stated in the source text.
Amends title 38, United States Code, to add a new reporting requirement section.
dimensions.evidence: Chapter 24 of title 38, United States Code, is amended by adding at the end the following new section

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent annual reporting requirement starting one year after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than one year after the date of the enactment... and on an annual basis thereafter

missing_information: Specific cost estimates or budgetary appropriations for generating the annual report.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to submit an annual report on the National Cemetery Administration to congressional committees and publish it online, resulting in administrative oversight and transparency changes without direct broad population or fiscal impacts.
